title: Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss passes for 336 yards, runs for 60 in 41-38 win in opener

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss passes for 336 yards, runs for 60 in 41-38 win in opener
sources.description: Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss, who may prove to be among the most polarizing prospects in the 2027 NFL draft, is off to a good start to his final season of college football.
